title: Streamlight LiteBox 1Million 3,300-Lumen Spotlight

comparisons.notes: Streamlight LiteBox 1Million in orange, same 3,300-lumen / 1,250,000-candela specs. Listed in stock, new, in three styles from $355.99 to $385.99; $355.99 is the lowest style, used as the conservative market price.

writeup: The Streamlight LiteBox 1Million rechargeable spotlight is $119.99 at Woot, matched by its ASIN to model 46201, the Standard System with the AC/DC charging kit. It puts out 3,300 lumens and a 1,250,000-candela beam. L.N. Curtis sells the LiteBox 1Million from $355.99, so this is about 66% less. Woot doesn't state condition, so we held it to our stricter refurb bar and it still cleared. Quantity is very limited.
amazon_match_notes: ASIN from the Woot offer payload, confirmed by the price checker as Streamlight LiteBox 1Million model 46201 Standard System (UPC 080926462014).
